messages:
terry: quick flag from product  they keep missing KV cache wins in canary cards because we only show total delta. can we add a compact per-variant snapshot that surfaces tokens charged vs cache_saved_tokens? :eyes:

anya: yes please. ideal columns: route, variant, invocations, tokens_charged, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, reasons[], approx(boolean). add a normalized net_delta_per_1k_invokes for fair comparison.

sid: implementation note: we should emit a single compact snapshot at snapshot time (producer aggregates locally). POST /internal/v1/snapshots accepts an array of rows. don't re-ingest full timeseries. mark approx=true when producer used sampling and include sample_size.

chi: UX: show paired bars per-variant (red = billed spend, green = cache savings shown as a negative bar). toggle per-invocation vs per-token. tooltip shows cents + token counts. export CSV option requested by PMs.

terry: product also wants an "explain" pill: top_reason enum (model_swap|token_shift|prompt_change) + confidence percent and a one-line human explanation. keep heuristics simple and auditable.

sid: heuristic sketch: if variant_id != baseline -> model_swap. if median token length shifts >20% -> token_shift. if prompt overlap <60% -> prompt_change. confidence = function(sample_size, magnitude). store baseline_snapshot_id so we don't reconstruct history.

anya: retention/immutability: snapshots must be signed and stored immutable for audit customers. default retention 90d, allow enterprise overrides.

ingest-bot: snapshot uploaded rollout=canary-2026-03-28T09:00Z by @terry (4 rows, signed)

sid: action items: 1) sid -> draft POST contract + example payloads + aggregator SQL (ETA Tue) 2) anya -> mock stacked bar + toggle + CSV (ETA Wed) 3) chi -> design explain pill copy + confidence tooltip (ETA Thu) 4) terry -> update rollout runbook and retention ask.

terry: ok keeping this thread as the decision log. thanks all.
